title: Friday Squid Blogging: The Largest Squid Ever Filmed
content_md: This is the story of the largest squid ever filmed, in December 2006 near Japan’s Ogasawara Islands. As usual, you can also use this squid post to talk about the security stories in the news that I haven’t covered. Blog moderation policy.
exclude_reason: Squid blogging post, not a security event.
